{{Quote|The Gungan is Benbul Leedee and he can identify dozens of our covert operatives all over Naboo. He must be silenced.|Kima Nazith to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Benbul Leedee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Information broker/Legends|informant]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Kima Nazith]] commissioned a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to [[Death/Legends|killing]] Leedee, after he betrayed the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and aligned with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Benbul Leedee was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
